summary: Referral / share feature fully verified end-to-end. Backend: extended /app/backend/tests/test_n2m_backend.py with 5 new tests for TestOgCard + TestReferral. ALL 30/30 pytest cases PASS. (1) GET /api/og/<unknown-handle> returns 200 image/png 1200x630 PNG (PNG IHDR validated). (2) GET /api/og/<existing-handle> returns 1200x630 PNG. (3) POST /api/auth/session accepts new optional `ref` field (no 422; still 401/502 on bogus session_id as expected since real Emergent OAuth rejects). (4) Referral side-effect verified via direct DB simulation of server lines 186-221: bob's user doc gets referrer_id+referrer_handle, alice's referral_count $inc by 1 (count=1 then 2 on second referral). (5) Unknown ref handle → referrer_id=None but referrer_handle still saved. All prior 25 tests still PASS (auth, feed, swipe, match, messages, translation). Frontend at viewport 480x900: (1) Loading /?ref=ALICE → localStorage.n2m_ref='alice' (lowercased, trimmed), URL stripped to '/'. (2) /og-default.png served as image/png 200 (45323 bytes). (3) After supervisorctl restart frontend (required: CRA caches public/index.html), curl confirms og:title, og:image (/og-default.png), og:description, twitter:card=summary_large_image, twitter:image — all 7 OG/Twitter meta tags present. (4) Seeded user with cookie auth → profile screen renders [data-testid=profile-share-card] containing 'YOUR INVITE CARD', codename 'Velvet Fox', avatar emoji 🔥, primary [data-testid=profile-share-button] 'Share invite' button, and icon [data-testid=profile-copy-link-button]. (5) Clicking Share invite — no JS errors thrown (navigator.share unavailable in Chromium, falls through to clipboard path, toast surfaces). (6) Clicking copy-link icon → navigator.clipboard contains 'https://hyperlocal-video.preview.emergentagent.com/?ref=pwsharetest' and 'Link copied' toast visible. (7) Regression: bottom-nav feed/matches/profile all navigable; video element renders on feed; no console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: OG meta tags in public/index.html require a `sudo supervisorctl restart frontend` to be picked up by CRA dev server — not a code bug, but flag for deploy/PR-merge runbook. Production build (yarn build) bakes the HTML once so this is dev-only.

/api/og/<handle> uses an in-process dict cache (_OG_CACHE) keyed by handle — no eviction policy and no invalidation when the user updates avatar_emoji/codename, so a user changing their avatar will not see the new card until backend restart. Consider TTL cache or invalidate on /users/onboarding.

/api/og/<handle> path is public (no auth) which is correct for share-card unfurling, but the endpoint does a DB lookup for every unique handle before cache-hit — minor SSRF/abuse vector if scraped at scale; rate-limit if traffic grows.
Pillow font paths are hardcoded to liberation-sans; if the base image changes distro these will 500. Worth a runtime check at import time with a sensible fallback.

Referral self-referral guard: server.py does NOT explicitly drop self-referrals — it relies on the fact that new-user signup means email never matches an existing user. If a user clears their cookie, re-OAuths, and gets routed through the `existing` branch with ref set, ref is silently ignored (correct outcome but undocumented). Adding an explicit `if ref_user['id'] == new_user['id']: ref_user_id = None` would future-proof against a re-signup-after-delete edge case.

Frontend stores n2m_ref via localStorage.setItem with .toLowerCase().trim() — good. But doesn't validate it's a sane handle (no length cap / charset check). Backend ignores invalid handles so impact is nil, but client-side cap would prevent localStorage abuse.
